summary.zh-CN: 未启用的消息渠道现在按需运行，显著降低空闲内存；聊天同时加入消息片段引用、更完整的媒体预览和模型发现体验。
summary.en-US: Unused messaging channels now run on demand to reduce idle memory, with conversation excerpt references, richer media previews, and better model discovery.

body.zh-CN: 未启用的消息渠道不再常驻独立进程；运行中启用、禁用或发起授权时，对应运行时会自动启动或回收。
body.en-US: Unused messaging channels no longer keep separate processes resident; enabling, disabling, or authorizing a channel starts or releases its runtime automatically.

body.zh-CN: ARM64 Linux 空配置三轮平均 working set 从旧版本约 865～885 MiB 降至 164.94 MiB，下降约 81%；其他架构和活跃任务会随实际工作变化。
body.en-US: The three-run ARM64 Linux empty-configuration average fell from about 865–885 MiB to 164.94 MiB, about 81% lower; other architectures and active workloads will vary.

body.zh-CN: 用户或 AI 历史消息中的选中文本可以作为结构化引用发送，AI 会收到选中时的精确快照。
body.en-US: Selected text from earlier user or AI messages can be sent as a structured reference containing the exact captured snapshot.

body.zh-CN: 图片与 Mermaid 图表支持全屏、适应窗口、缩放、拖拽、复位，以及复制图片或源码。
body.en-US: Images and Mermaid diagrams support full-screen viewing, fit-to-window, zoom, pan, reset, and copy actions.

body.zh-CN: 新模型提醒保持可见，模型目录支持搜索、提供商筛选、逐项添加和忽略当前提醒。
body.en-US: New-model notices remain visible, while the model catalog supports search, provider filters, individual additions, and dismissing the current notice.

body.zh-CN: 右侧快捷栏移除低频服务应用默认入口；服务应用仍可从应用页面访问并按需固定。
body.en-US: The low-frequency Service Apps shortcut is removed from the right dock; Service Apps remain available from the Apps page and can be pinned when needed.

body.zh-CN: 结构化引用的删除按钮会稳定出现；文件和消息划选浮层在选择完成后及时显示并避让视口。
body.en-US: Structured-reference removal stays available, and selection controls for files and messages appear after selection while remaining within the viewport.

body.zh-CN: 已有 enabled 渠道继续正常启动；未启用或没有配置的渠道默认保持停止。
body.en-US: Existing enabled channels continue to start normally, while disabled or unconfigured channels remain stopped by default.
